investigations.name: fig1-architecture
investigations.description:
Representative / architecture-demonstration fidelity. This study demonstrates
the ARCHITECTURE — that the reduced-but-genuine submodels compose into one
integrated cell that runs — not a quantitative fit of any single phenotype
(those live in fig2-growth, fig3-expression, fig5-energy). Metabolism and mass
run on a coarse 60 s timestep to keep FBA cost reasonable; the stochastic
expression processes run at 1 s. The wiring matrix is read straight from the
composite doc, so the diagram is the model, not an illustration of it.
Achieved (committed run, 1200 s): 6 processes, 3 cell variables coupled across
≥2 submodels (growth_fraction, rna_counts, protein_counts), growth_fraction
1.000 at the end, mass grew 3.93 → 4.03 fg. Stochastic expression is low over
20 min, so distinct mRNA/protein species produced were 0 — expected and not a
fidelity claim of this study.
investigations.title: Fig 1 — Whole-cell integration: six submodels wired through shared cell variables
investigations.objective:
Does viva-Mgen actually reproduce Fig 1's central architectural claim — that
the whole-cell model is a set of independent submodels *integrated* through a
shared set of cell variables — as a real, runnable composite rather than a
drawing? Do all six submodels compose, share stores, and run as one integrated
cell?

investigations.name: fig2-growth
investigations.description:
FULL FIDELITY for the growth/composition phenotype. Metabolism is real FBA on
the published Suthers 2009 iPS189 reconstruction; mass integration uses the
Karr 2012 fitted cell-cycle length and dry-weight fractions. The metabolism
growth flux is calibrated so unperturbed growth (growth_fraction = 1.0) doubles
the cell in the fitted 9 h — the same doubling time measured for M. genitalium
and reproduced in Fig 2A/B. Achieved (committed production run): doubling time
9.000 h, mass ratio 2.000 over the cycle, protein fraction 0.620 of dry mass.
investigations.title: Fig 2 — Cell growth: 9 h doubling time and protein-dominant composition
investigations.objective:
Does the reduced-but-genuine viva-Mgen cell (FBA metabolism over iPS189
driving mass accumulation) reproduce the trained whole-cell model's core
growth phenotype from Fig 2 — a ~9 h doubling time and a protein-dominant
dry-mass composition?

investigations.name: fig3-expression
investigations.description: Now GENUINELY MODELED (not a reduced analog): a coordinate-resolved ChromosomeDynamicsReproductionProcess bins the 580,070 bp chromosome, initiates RNA polymerases at gene sites (locus-tag-ordered positions) and elongates them, advances two replisomes bidirectionally from oriC, places structural proteins (SMC/SSB/gyrase/topo/DnaA/TFs), and detects+resolves polymerase-protein collisions. Reproduces Fig 3A (occupancy density), 3B (chromosome exploration kinetics), 3C (% RNA expressed / t50), 3D (polymerase position kymograph), 3E (collision-frequency matrix), 3F (collisions vs binding density). REDUCED fidelity: binned genome + approximate (locus-ordered) gene coordinates + representative protein counts.
investigations.title: Fig 3 — Chromosome DNA-protein interactions (viva-Mgen)
investigations.objective:
Does the reduced viva-Mgen expression module (stochastic transcription +
translation + RNA/protein decay on a representative gene panel) reproduce the
qualitative single-cell gene-expression dynamics of Fig 3 / 2G-2H — bursty,
low-copy mRNA alongside protein that accumulates to much higher, more stable
copy numbers (the mRNA↔protein decoupling)?

investigations.name: fig4-cell-cycle
investigations.description:
REDUCED MECHANISM, GENUINE DYNAMICS. This is a clean-room reproduction of the
emergent cell-cycle regulation Karr 2012 uncovered, not the full
replisome/Okazaki-fragment machinery of the original Replication submodel. The
mechanism is genuine: a dNTP-buffered three-phase cycle (initiation ->
replication -> done) in which DnaA accumulates stochastically to a threshold to
fire initiation, dNTPs accumulate unconsumed during initiation, and the
resulting surplus sets the speed of the deterministic, dNTP-limited replication
phase. No gene explicitly regulates cycle length; the buffering is emergent
from that coupling. Achieved (committed production run, 128/128 cells
completing): r(initiation, replication) = -0.930 (Fig 4E),
r(dNTP-at-start, replication) = -0.951 (Fig 4D),
r(initial DnaA, initiation) = -0.743 (Fig 4C).
investigations.title: Fig 4 — Emergent, unregulated control of cell-cycle duration
investigations.objective:
Does the viva-Mgen replication submodel reproduce Fig 4's central finding —
that M. genitalium's cell-cycle duration is controlled *emergently*, without a
dedicated genetic regulator, through the coupling of replication initiation and
a dNTP surplus that it builds up?

investigations.name: fig5-energy
investigations.description:
REDUCED FIDELITY. Of the energy carriers only ATP and GTP are modeled — NAD,
FAD and NADP are not — and the process energy shares are computed only from the
two reduced expression processes actually wired in the composite: transcription
(NTP) and translation (GTP). tRNA-aminoacylation, the ~15% second slice of the
paper's budget, is not a separate process here. The study therefore reproduces
the QUALITATIVE Fig 5 findings — the ATP > GTP synthesis ordering (Fig 5A) and
the translation-dominated expression budget (Fig 5D) — but NOT the exact
29% / 15% / 7% / 44% split. Achieved (committed production run): ATP:GTP
synthesis ratio 4.03 (ATP flux 0.813 vs GTP flux 0.202, iPS189 units), and of
the modeled expression energy translation is 96.8% vs transcription 3.2%
(9.83M GTP vs 0.32M NTP over the hour). The Fig 5D donut additionally shows a
representative ~44% "unaccounted" slice to echo the paper's structure; it is a
fixed illustrative value, not a measured quantity of this reduced model.
investigations.title: Fig 5 — Global distribution of cellular energy: ATP > GTP synthesis and a translation-dominated budget
investigations.objective:
Does the reduced viva-Mgen cell reproduce Fig 5's global energy picture — that
ATP and GTP are the dominant synthesized carriers with ATP > GTP (Fig 5A), and
that the cellular energy budget is dominated by translation, ahead of
transcription (Fig 5D)?

investigations.name: fig6-gene-essentiality
investigations.description:
HIGH FIDELITY over the metabolic subset. Essentiality is assessed only for the
125 genes present in the published Suthers 2009 iPS189 reconstruction that also
carry a reference essentiality call — not all 525 M. genitalium genes. This is
the appropriate scope: FBA can only speak to metabolic-gene disruptions, which
the paper identifies as the most debilitating. A gene is called model-essential
when its single knockout drives FBA growth_fraction below 0.05 (growth
collapse). Reference essentiality is the ``essential_ref`` column of
``datasets/genes.csv``, extracted from the Karr 2012 repo's
allDeletionSimulations.json. Achieved (committed production run over 125 genes):
accuracy 0.760, sensitivity 0.755, specificity 0.789; confusion matrix
[[TP 80, FN 26], [FP 4, TN 15]] (106 reference-essential, 19 reference-
non-essential). The representative MG_023 knockout collapses growth_fraction to
0.000, confirming detection of an essential gene.
investigations.title: Fig 6A — Single-gene-disruption essentiality: model vs experiment
investigations.objective:
Does the viva-Mgen FBA metabolism submodel reproduce Fig 6A — the
single-gene-disruption essentiality phenotype — for the metabolic genes of
M. genitalium: does an in-silico single-gene knockout predict which genes are
essential, matching the reference essentiality calls?

investigations.name: fig7-kinetic-parameters
investigations.description:
REDUCED / representative fidelity. kcat is modelled as a multiplicative scale
on a target reaction's FBA flux bound (a Vmax proxy) via
MetabolismFbaReproductionProcess(config={"reaction_bound_scale": {rid: s}}),
NOT explicit enzyme kinetics; the specific lpdA/deoD/thyA genetics are not
individually modelled. run.py first scans candidate reactions (central-carbon
shortlist plus every reaction carrying flux at the optimum) at scales
{0.05, 0.2, 1.0} and keeps those that are both limiting (growth drops when
throttled) and saturating (growth back at the wild-type plateau by 0.2x). The
chosen primary target is the leucine-uptake reaction EX_leu_DASH_L_e — an
amino-acid transporter Vmax proxy; M. genitalium is auxotrophic for most amino
acids, so amino-acid provisioning is a real growth-limiting kinetic step, the
same qualitative role the paper's biosynthetic enzymes play. Lysine uptake
(EX_lys_DASH_L_e) and potassium uptake (EX_k_e) are shown as secondary series.
Achieved (committed production run) for EX_leu_DASH_L_e: monotonic
(growth_is_monotonic_in_kcat = 1.0), saturating (growth_saturates = 1.0),
dynamic_range = 0.864 (growth 0.136 at 0.01x rising to 1.000 at >=0.1x).
investigations.title: Fig 7E-G — Kinetic parameters: growth depends sigmoidally on an enzyme's kcat (Vmax proxy)
investigations.objective:
Does the reduced-but-genuine viva-Mgen cell reproduce Fig 7E-G's central
quantitative claim — that predicted growth rate depends on an enzyme's kinetic
parameter (kcat/Vmax), producing a SIGMOIDAL growth-vs-kcat curve that rises
from near-zero at low activity and saturates at the wild-type rate once the
enzyme is no longer rate-limiting?
